description: Boundary coverage for certification error normalization: selectors that do not match any eligible foreign package must normalize to not_a_foreign_package in both JSON and text formats, including an empty selector, a numeric selector, mixed punctuation, and non-ASCII unicode. All preserve the rejected selector verbatim, the domain message, and remediation help, with no host-language exception leakage.
